mapper.insert: insert into tlias.student (name, no, gender, phone, degree, id_card, is_college, address, graduation_date, clazz_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{no}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{degree}, #{idCard}, #{isCollege}, #{address}, #{graduationDate}, #{clazzId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select s.id, name, no, gender, phone, degree, id_card, is_college, address, graduation_date, violation_count, violation_score, clazz_id, clazz_name, create_time, update_time from tlias.student s

select s.id, name, no, gender, phone, degree, id_card, is_college, address, graduation_date, violation_count, violation_score, clazz_id, create_time, update_time from tlias.student s where s.id = #{id}

select (case when degree = '1' then '初中' when degree = '2' then '高中' when degree = '3' then '专科' when degree = '4' then '本科' when degree = '5' then '硕士' else '其他' end) degree, count(*) num from tlias.student group by degree order by degree
select c.name name, count(s.id) num from tlias.clazz c left join tlias.student s on c.id = s.clazz_id group by c.id, c.name order by num
